sql:
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IN (
    SELECT `Enrollment (K-12)`
    FROM frpm
    ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
    LIMIT 10 OFFSET 9
)
